dataset.case_hash_encoding: SHA256 over ordered ASCII prompt + TAB + answer + LF
dataset.combined_hash_encoding: SHA256 over each delay + TAB + train hash + TAB + validation hash + LF
dataset.grammar: two xyz prefix chars + one payload bit + D xyz distractors + '?'
dataset.split: sample unique noise histories per delay; first 8 train, next min(32,3^(D+2)-8) validation; each history paired with both payloads; no history shared across splits
dataset.vocabulary_fitted_on: union of training prompts from all stages, never validation

device_identity: Some(DeviceIdentity { name: "AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT", fingerprint: "spirv_4098_30096", physical: Some(PhysicalDevice { pci_address: None, luid: None, registry_entry_id: None, vendor: Some(Amd) }) })

protocol.frozen_diagnostics: same xy0+x^D+? and xy1+x^D+? pair, all delays, before curriculum and after its last reached stage; no optimizer updates during diagnostics
protocol.initialization: fresh identical initial parameters per seed/path, fresh Adam per path; parameters and Adam moments carry across that path's curriculum stages
protocol.isolation: memory-only/spikes-only gate both couplings off and gate the opposite readout off; full uses Both; same parameters, forward graph, surrogate/reset equations, and shared optimizer implementation
protocol.loss: full-vocabulary mean cross entropy only after final '?' input; all earlier masks zero; each target equals sole payload digit at position 2
protocol.milestone: at final delay 16: training accuracy >=99% and held-out accuracy >=95%, for at least 2 of 3 default seeds per path
protocol.state: all recurrent states reset independently per prompt/fullbatch update
protocol.stop_rule: training accuracy exactly 100% and answer NLL <= 0.1 at each 25-update check or last update; advance if passed, otherwise stop path after stage cap
protocol.validation: evaluate once per reached stage after training stops; never used for updates, stopping, or checkpoint selection

backward.interpretation: Each payload digit occurs only at input position 2, so its embedding-row gradient measures loss credit reaching that input. Full-path credit sums the spike and memory input routes. These are not temporal Jacobians: confidence and operating points differ across delays. No claim about unretained intermediate-state gradients.

margin_backward.interpretation: Local output-margin sensitivity without a softmax/CE confidence multiplier. It uses the specified surrogate for spikes and is not a pure temporal Jacobian; operating points differ across delays. Full-path embedding credit combines both input routes.
margin_backward.objective: mean final correct-payload-bit logit minus other-payload-bit logit
